definition: Added, extra, or supplementary to what already exists
examples: We need additional information before making a final decision.

definition: A routine task, especially a household one
examples: Doing the dishes is my least favorite household chore.

definition: A mark indicating a student's level of achievement in a course or test
examples: She worked hard to get a good grade on her final exam.

definition: Clothes and linen that need to be washed or have just been washed
examples: I have a huge pile of dirty laundry to wash this weekend.

definition: Time free from work or other duties, used for rest and recreation
examples: In his leisure time, he enjoys reading and hiking.

definition: Relating to or occurring in a particular area, city, or neighborhood
examples: We bought fresh vegetables at the local market.

definition: The smallest basic unit of a chemical element
examples: Water molecules consist of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

definition: Constituting the typical or ordinary amount, rate, or level
examples: The average temperature in July is twenty-five degrees.

definition: Loose-fitting and hanging in loose folds
examples: He likes to wear baggy jeans and oversized sweatshirts.

definition: Something that is very important or significant
examples: Passing the final exam was a big deal for him.

definition: A plan or drawing produced to show the look and function of something before it is made
examples: The architect showed us the new design for the building.

definition: To convey a thought, feeling, or opinion in words or through actions
examples: He found it hard to express his emotions clearly.

definition: A small mechanical or electronic device or tool, especially an ingenious or novel one
examples: He loves buying the latest electronic gadgets.

definition: A person who is knowledgeable and enthusiastic about a specific subject, especially technology
examples: As a computer geek, he spends all his free time programming.

definition: To take hold of something suddenly or roughly
examples: He grabbed his jacket and ran out the door.

definition: A sweatshirt with a hood attached
examples: She put on a comfortable hoodie because it was chilly outside.

definition: Having long sleeves that reach down to the wrists
examples: He wore a long-sleeved shirt to keep warm in the evening.

definition: Not fitting tightly or closely; baggy
examples: He prefers wearing loose clothes in hot weather.

definition: A person who is extremely interested in a technical or academic subject and lacks social skills
examples: He was considered a science nerd in high school.

definition: Having short sleeves that do not reach the elbow
examples: She bought a short-sleeved t-shirt for the summer.

definition: A short and memorable phrase used in advertising or branding
examples: The company came up with a catchy new slogan for its product.

definition: A cultural group within a larger culture, often having beliefs or interests at variance with the larger culture
examples: Punk rock gave rise to a distinctive youth subculture.

definition: A young person who is exceptionally intelligent, successful, or skilled in a particular field
examples: The tech startup was founded by a twenty-year-old computer whizz-kid.

definition: Available for immediate sale or use in a store
examples: The store employee said the shoes were currently in stock.

definition: A written acknowledgment that a specified sum of money or article has been received
examples: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.

definition: A standardized measurement for clothing, footwear, or object dimensions
examples: Do you have these pants in a smaller size?

definition: Having all available items or tickets completely sold
examples: The concert tickets were completely sold out within minutes.

definition: A shop that sells non-mainstream, vintage, or subcultural fashion and goods
examples: She bought her jacket at an alternative shop downtown.

definition: To talk in a friendly, informal way
examples: We sat in the cafe and chatted for hours.

definition: Fashionable, attractive, or impressive in a way that is admired
examples: He was wearing a very cool pair of sunglasses.

definition: An area marked off for playing a sports game, such as tennis or basketball
examples: They met at the basketball court after school.

definition: Fashion trends that are widely accepted and worn by the general public
examples: She prefers vintage clothing rather than following mainstream fashion.

definition: The activity of looking at items displayed in shop windows without intending to buy anything
examples: We spent the afternoon window-shopping at the mall.

definition: A slide at a swimming pool or water park down which people slide into water
examples: The kids spent all day riding the huge waterslide at the water park.

definition: To reduce the amount or consumption of something, especially expenditure
examples: We need to cut back on unnecessary expenses this month.

definition: The money spent on something
examples: Monthly living expenses can add up very quickly.

definition: Money received, especially on a regular basis, for work or through investments
examples: Her monthly income is enough to cover all her living expenses.

definition: To stay informed about or monitor the status and movement of something
examples: It is useful to use an app to keep track of your daily spending.

definition: A goal or target that you want to achieve in the distant future
examples: Buying a house is a long-term goal for many young couples.

definition: To control, budget, and organize one's financial resources effectively
examples: Learning how to manage money is an essential skill for adults.

definition: A small amount of money given regularly to children by parents, or money for minor personal expenses
examples: He earns his pocket money by doing household chores.

definition: To make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size
examples: The store reduced its prices to attract more customers.

definition: Money that has been saved over time, especially in a bank
examples: She used all her savings to buy a new car.

definition: To plan and decide how much money will be spent over a period
examples: We need to set a budget before going on vacation.

definition: A helpful piece of advice or practical information
examples: Here are a few useful tips on how to save money on groceries.

definition: A particular part, feature, or phase of something
examples: Safety is an important aspect of any job.

definition: Fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, or plans; easy to use
examples: Online shopping is very convenient because you can shop from home.

definition: A step leading up to the outer door of a building
examples: The courier left the package right on our doorstep.

definition: Merchandise or items produced for sale
examples: The shop sells high-quality consumer goods.

definition: In a rushed or hasty manner; needing to do something quickly
examples: I was in a hurry this morning and forgot my keys.

definition: A feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment
examples: Reading books gives her a lot of pleasure.

definition: To acquire something by paying money for it; to buy
examples: He saved enough money to purchase a new laptop.
